title: Root Xiaomi Pad 5 in 1 Minute Fast HyperOS Magisk Guide
blurb: Rooting the Xiaomi Pad 5 on HyperOS takes about a minute once you have the files — here's the exact command-by-command method.
video_description:
Rooting the Xiaomi Pad 5 on HyperOS takes about a minute once you have the files — here's the exact command-by-command method.

No drama, and no flashing a whole custom ROM. You boot a modded TWRP with fastboot boot, push Magisk in through adb, install it from recovery, and reboot. That's the whole thing. The transcript of this video is basically me doing it live, so you can follow along keystroke for keystroke.

The reason it works so cleanly is the modded TWRP for the Pad 5. Stock recovery won't help you here, and that's the file most people miss. Grab it, grab Magisk, and you're set.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi Pad 5
🧩 Root    : Magisk (via modded TWRP)
🤖 Android : HyperOS
👤 Credits : akrt · @misha

🛠️ What You Need
• Xiaomi Pad 5 with an unlocked bootloader
• The modded TWRP image for the Pad 5
• The Magisk APK
• adb and fastboot tool plus the driver installed on your PC

📝 Steps
1. Connect the tablet to your PC and open your adb and fastboot tool.
2. Reboot the device to fastboot.
3. Boot the modded TWRP image with fastboot boot.
4. Once TWRP is up, push the Magisk APK with adb push.
5. Install it from inside TWRP.
6. Run adb reboot and confirm Magisk is active.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Using stock recovery instead of the modded TWRP — it won't work.
• Forgetting the driver, so adb never sees the tablet.
• Not opening Magisk once after reboot to finish the setup.

❓ Common Questions
Q: Does rooting wipe my data?
A: This method doesn't touch your data, but unlocking the bootloader already does if you haven't done it yet.
Q: Can I unroot later?
A: Yes. Magisk has an uninstall path, and a clean ROM flash always removes root.
Q: Why modded TWRP instead of the normal one?
A: The standard recovery won't handle this properly on the Pad 5. Use the modded image.
